entity.description: A person's qualification: a degree, certificate, licence, work experience, identity document or work permit (IronStone People design §10 Qualifications, PE-14; impl-people P18; refined from the commented sketch, F6). Each has its own identity (a renewal is a new row naming the one it renews, so earlier evidence stays), a type, issuer, reference (the document or certificate number), valid dates and a verification state: submitted (QlVerPending), verified, rejected or revoked by an authorized verifier, never by the person (the state audit-logged with the verifier's reason). An identity document or work permit (QualIdentityDocument, QualWorkPermit and the types under them) needs an expiry, and its reference is read only by the person and HR of an employer of theirs. Its files are on its own content host (PartyQualificationContent, PE-01), never on the Party: the person and HR read them. Staffing reads only whether a verified qualification is valid or expiring (mantle.humanres.DevelopmentServices .check#Qualifications). Written through DevelopmentServices store#Qualification and verify#Qualification.

entity.description: A file of an employment: a contract, a letter, an identity or right-to-work document (IronStone People design §13 RecordFiles, PE-01; impl-people P2). The employment is People's content host, keyed by its partyRelationshipId, so an HR file is never on the person's broadly visible Party record; get#RecordLinkInfo and RecordFiles admit it only to a People HR reader of the employer (mantle.humanres.PeopleServices.check#EmploymentAccess), and it has no Records-drive folder, so nothing shares it. Written through mantle.humanres.PeopleServices.create#EmploymentContent.

A dated assignment inside an employment (IronStone People design §4, PE-02; impl-people P6): the department, primary position, manager, work location and working schedule (P9) of the employment from fromDate until thruDate, and its state (working, or on a leave of absence). A transfer, a manager change or a leave ends the assignment in effect and starts the next, so history is kept and the payroll identity (the employment) is not split; one primary assignment at a time, inside the employment's dates. The assignment is the source of the employment's manager (per employment: a person employed by two employers has a manager at each), its department membership (a dated PrtMember row from role Assignee to the department) and its position occupancy (a dated EmplPositionParty row), which mantle.humanres.PeopleServices hire#Employee and apply#EmploymentChange keep as projections in the same transaction; the reporting line is a PrtManager row from the manager to the person. partyId and organizationPartyId are the employment's, kept here for the reads by person and employer. Written only by PeopleServices (Employment.js) and OrganizationServices (a manager change, a unit's closure).
